description: Fires when column 1 (second from left) holds exactly three stones, so the next stone there lands on row 3 (fourth row), unless some other column has an immediate win or must-block. Strongest when the opponent just made column 1 three high and/or (3,1) is itself an immediate win or must-block; weak in the first ~10 plies. Never fires when column 1 has 0-2 or 4+ stones.
effect: Modest and inconsistent: zeroing it moves a few points (3-16) from columns 1-2 to the centre column 3; forcing it high shifts 10-30 points away from columns 3/4 toward columns 0-2. No effect when the move is forced.
notes: Core variable is heights[1]==3 (alone: F1 0.50, recall 0.91, AUROC 0.93); activation is a graded continuum and most h1==3 positions sit just below threshold, limiting precision. Minimal pairs: col-1 height 4 kills it; urgent move elsewhere suppresses it; urgency at (3,1) and opponent just playing col 1 boost it. Stone ownership in col 1 did not help. Best dev F1 0.514 (P 0.39, R 0.76), sim share 0.91. Remaining variance from distant stones not explained.
